import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_30/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_30/training_1.csv"

df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# According to operation_history: JOIN on ["movieId", "movieId"]
# Source0 schema: ['userId', 'movieId', 'tag', 'timestamp']
# Source1 schema: ['movieId', 'title', 'genres']

# Perform inner join on 'movieId'
df_joined = pd.merge(df_source0, df_source1, on='movieId', how='inner')

# Reorder and cast columns to match target schema:
# Target schema: ['movieId': int, 'title': str, 'genres': str, 'userId': int, 'tag': str, 'timestamp': int]

# Ensure correct dtypes
df_joined['movieId'] = df_joined['movieId'].astype(int)
df_joined['title'] = df_joined['title'].astype(str)
df_joined['genres'] = df_joined['genres'].astype(str)
df_joined['userId'] = df_joined['userId'].astype(int)
df_joined['tag'] = df_joined['tag'].astype(str)
df_joined['timestamp'] = df_joined['timestamp'].astype(int)

# Select and order columns as per target schema
df_target = df_joined[['movieId', 'title', 'genres', 'userId', 'tag', 'timestamp']]

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_30/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_30/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_30/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on movieId
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="movieId", how="inner")

# Group by the leftmost columns of the target schema except timestamp (which is dependent on tag)
# According to FD: tag -> timestamp, so timestamp is aggregated by max to keep the latest timestamp per tag
grouped = joined.groupby(["movieId", "title", "genres", "userId", "tag"], as_index=False).agg({"timestamp": "max"})

# Write output with exact target schema column order
grouped = grouped[["movieId", "title", "genres", "userId", "tag", "timestamp"]]
grouped.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_30/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
